title: W4 H2 -- The one emphasis rule
description: UI wave 4, plan docs/agent-work/2026-10-28-ui-wave-4/PLAN.md section '### H2' -- read the whole task (Files, Interfaces, Steps, Acceptance, Fail-first, Stop and ask, Default) plus the plan's Rules, hotspot-ownership and Notes sections before starting. Plan APPROVED by the owner 2026-10-28 with all open-question defaults. Register team-serial-check-slot only while running heavy checks; private Playwright config/port; double-quote paths; no git stash/checkout/reset; no package installs.

handoff.text: Owner decision 2026-10-28 (after seeing the 10-13 px neighbour shift): NO-SHIFT bold. Keep one shared rule and the 4% scale (transform, no reflow), but replace the font-weight change with a width-neutral faux bold: -webkit-text-stroke (token --emph-stroke, about 0.03-0.04em, currentColor) so a hovered/focused label looks semibold but its layout width is unchanged; neighbours must move 0 px (assert layout width and neighbour offsets unchanged, not just <20%). Tune the stroke against a true 600 screenshot of Snapshot/Append to section and record both crops. Danger stays red; Reduce Motion drops the scale but keeps the stroke. Keep everything else in T175 as approved-quality. Rulings for H3: label:has(input) rows join the catch-all; H3 registers src/organization/fragments.css for .fragment-link; .prose-issue-dismiss and .footnote-source in src/editor/editor.css are deferred to H4 (after G3 releases editor.css); restore the :active press on div.dropdown-option within the shared rule.

review.note: Reviewed styles.css emphasis block (one catch-all, stroke 0.04em currentColor + 1.04 scale, Reduce Motion drops scale only, inputs inside labels un-stroked, danger colour untouched since stroke=currentColor) and designTokens diff. vitest motion+designTokens 29 pass. Reran 'H2 emphasis' on a fresh build (port 1672): passes, widths identical, all neighbour shifts 0, scale 1.04, stroke ~0.5px. Snapshot stroke vs true-600 crops visually comparable. Not checked: native WebKit rendering of -webkit-text-stroke; tuning was in Chromium fallback font only, so check Futura in the Mac app.

(5) popover.css:34 and research.css:519 hover weights remain for H3. Chromium only.
